mapper.sql: user_id, account, email, nick_name, password, avatar, gender, birth_date, height, weight, role_type, status, register_time, last_login_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_info ( user_id, account, email, nick_name, password, avatar, gender, birth_date, height, weight, role_type, status, register_time, last_login_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{account}, #{email}, #{nickName}, #{password}, #{avatar}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{roleType}, #{status}, #{registerTime}, #{lastLoginTime}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_info SET password = #{password}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_info SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_info SET last_login_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_info WHERE account = #{account} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM user_info WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_info WHERE account = #{account}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_info WHERE email = #{email}
